label: Whatever is GOD_4 is ALTOGETHER_IMMATERIAL_2: not composed of matter and form…, by Modus-tollens
meaning: God is not a matter-form composite, since that is a composition (q.3 a.7) and God is simple; and God is a component of nothing, since God is the first being (open bridge) and no component is the first being (q.3 a.8).
